releaseNotes: Finished the docs cutover the extraction started (layering plan phase D; R10). CONTRIBUTING now describes the engine-only repository — founder-product work is routed to the Formation-Platform repository — and gains the adapter-contract versioning section: what a contract change must move together in one commit (types + schemas, ADAPTER_CONTRACT_VERSION by its bump rules, regenerated golden samples with negative controls still failing) and what a major bump demands of every consumer pin.

docs/architecture.md's layer table is no longer labeled a target: phases A1-C landed 2026-08-19, so L0-L4 with the four contracts is current description, with composition by named profiles and packs (phase E) the one part still marked in flight.
